summary: Query route — voice snapshot at session creation, getSystemPrompt(session.voice) at query
description: IMPL §5. Two touch points in src/app/api/query/route.ts: (1) at sessions INSERT, snapshot voice = (tier==='pro' && isVoiceSlug(prefs.preferredVoice)) ? prefs.preferredVoice : 'scholar'; (2) at query execution, call getSystemPrompt(session.voice). Free users always 'scholar' regardless of stored pref. Profile voice changes do NOT mutate existing sessions (snapshot is immutable). See IMPL §5.

resolution.test_function: pro user with preferredVoice=woowoo snapshots woowoo onto the new session
resolution.note: Ownership SELECT now reads {id, voice}. Voice resolution block uses isVoiceSlug + tier gate; new sessions snapshot at INSERT time. Both /api/query auto-create and /api/sessions POST land voice on the row. Existing session voice wins over current pref (thread coherence). Defensive unknown-slug fallback to DEFAULT_VOICE. 9 new tests cover both paths + pro gate + downgrade preservation. 329 tests pass.
